CustomField.description: Optional tags for this template, for your own automation; the package's conversion does not read them. The sample Global Form Submission Utility flows, or your own automation, copy them onto each new submission's Data Conversion Tags so record-triggered flows can branch on which template produced a submission. A page section can set its own tags to override these.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Optional tags stamped onto each submission from this template - by the sample submission-utility flow or your own automation. Reference them in your own record-triggered Flow entry conditions to route or process submissions by template; the package's built-in conversion does not read them.
CustomField.label: Data Conversion Tag(s)
